name: ifslint
description: Lint and visualize QNX mkifs buildfiles (QNX SDP 8.0) — catch image build mistakes before you boot.

scripts.vsix: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('vscode/lib',{recursive:true});for(const f of ['rules.js','parser.js','tree.js'])fs.copyFileSync('dist/'+f,'vscode/lib/'+f)" && cd vscode && npx --yes @vscode/vsce@3 package --allow-missing-repository -o qnx-buildfile-0.1.0.vsix
